ValidationRule.description: Prevents a Terminated or Expired tenancy from being moved back to Active or Pending.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Terminated"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Expired") ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Active"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Pending") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Terminated or Expired tenancy cannot be reactivated.
